data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 1.9%.

Top probability drivers (from SHAP): (1) Low expected evaluation score (estimated 46.3) is the dominant negative—our offer is unlikely to be technically/competitively ranked. (2) Multiple compliance gaps (4) materially weaken responsiveness and risk disqualification. (3) Limited response time (240 hrs) slightly reduces our ability to close gaps and sharpen the submission.

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: PEC registration at C-A or C-1 with relevant specialization (requires qualifying entity/partner already holding the category, or a JV lead that does). Three completed road contracts ≥ PKR 700m each (requires teaming with a contractor that can evidence this via completion certificates). Average annual turnover ≥ PKR 1,500m for last three audited years (requires audited statements meeting threshold; likely via JV partner). Valid ISO 14001 for protected watershed-zone works (requires current certificate for bidding entity/JV; expedited certification is unlikely inside 10 days).

Recommendation: Only proceed if a compliant JV lead can be secured immediately; otherwise maintain NO-GO and redeploy bid resources.
